A spent missile-rack — emptied shoulder-pod with open launch-tubes, a lone trans-red-tipped missile remaining, cotton smoke-wisps at the muzzles, one volley left.
A pilot minifig at the foot — single flight-suited minifig craning upward at the titan's ankle, helmet visor raised, the one tiny figure that sells every inch of scale.
A crushed civilian-vehicle — flattened brick sedan under a grey rubble-chunk, printed door-tile visible, someone's abandoned commute caught in the mech's advance.
A warning-beacon — brick post with trans-orange and trans-red stacked round-plates flickering atop a yellow-black hazard-tile base, marking the mech's exclusion-zone on the tarmac.
A control-console with crew — brick console-bank of trans-blue readout-tiles and a printed holo-map tile, two operator-minifigs bent over it directing fire-solutions in real time.
A fallen enemy-mech head — severed brick mech-skull on scorched grey baseplates, a dead dark-grey eye-element cracked, char-tile debris radiating outward, the fight's final punctuation.
A repair-drone — small brick quad-rotor on a clear 4L rod, one clip-arm gripping a replacement armour-tile, tending the mech's gouged pauldron between engagements.
A hazard-stripe barrier — low brick wall in alternating yellow and black 1x4 tiles, a clipboard-tile prop and crew-minifig posted at the gap, holding the perimeter hard.
A cooling-vent stack — cluster of brick exhaust-stacks at the mech's spine, cotton-element heat-haze pouring out, trans-orange inner-glow bricks suggesting the reactor running dangerously hot.
A severed power-cable — thick brick-built conduit torn at the mech's hip joint, trans-yellow round-plates sparking along the break, a live hazard nobody has dared approach yet.
A fuel-tanker — brick articulated tanker-truck alongside the mech's boot, a minifig crew unhooking a plate-built fuel-hose, mid-transfer with the clock running.
A tool-rack and welding-rig — brick gantry hung with oversized wrench and torch builds, a trans-cyan arc-element at the torch tip, a tech-minifig mid-weld on the mech's knee-armour.
A fallen comrade-mech — a collapsed brick mech sprawled across the diorama floor, one arm outstretched, a shattered eye-element dark, the cost of the same battle still being fought.
Scattered shell-casing tiles — dozens of small gold and silver round-plates and 1x1 cone-elements littering the baseplate around the mech's feet, every one a story of rounds already fired.
An ammo and fuel-cell crate-stack — green and grey brick crates piled at the mech's heel, one lid off revealing trans-blue cell-elements inside, the rearm crew already working.
A fallen enemy-mech limb — a severed brick arm half-buried in rubble-chunks, actuator-rods exposed and bent, hydraulic-fluid dark tiles pooling beneath it, torn free and left behind.
A spotlight-rig — a tall brick tower with two angled headlight-bricks and trans-white cone-elements flooding the mech's work-bay in hard light, the night-shift repair running behind schedule.
A loose severed power-cable sparking — brick conduit snaked across three baseplates, trans-yellow and trans-white 1x1 round-plates bursting from the torn end, a danger to every minifig nearby.
A minifig medic beside fallen crew — a red-cross-tile medic-minifig kneeling at a downed colleague on a stretcher-build, the mech looming overhead still exchanging fire above them.
A battle-damage scorch patch — a scorched section of grey and black 1x1 tile-fragments radiating from a crater, a near-miss on the mech's base, proving the enemy shoots back.
